title: a16z Podcast: Mindsets for Engineering Biology

reader_summary.headline: Head of the largest bioengineering lab in the world.
reader_summary.overview: Head of the largest bioengineering lab in the world. What does it mean to move across disciplines like this, from science to engineering, both in the lab and into the field? In this conversation with general partner and head of the a16z bio fund Vijay Pande (with Hanne Tidnam).

key_points.text: Head of the largest bioengineering lab in the world.
In this conversation with general partner and head of the a16z bio fund Vijay Pande (with Hanne Tidnam).
At the heart of it all is "the interface of engineering and materials" in biology and healthcare innovation.
